entries.title: I Peter 5:1
segments: ¶The elders who are among you I exhort, I who am a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that will be revealed:

entries.title: I Peter 5:2
segments: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, serving as overseers, not by compulsion but willingly, not for dishonest gain but eagerly;

entries.title: I Peter 5:3
segments: nor as being lords over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock;

entries.title: I Peter 5:4
segments: and when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that does not fade away.

entries.title: I Peter 5:5
segments: ¶Likewise you younger people, submit yourselves to [your] elders. Yes, all of [you] be submissive to one another, and be clothed with humility, for "God resists the proud, But gives grace to the humble."

entries.title: I Peter 5:6
segments: Therefore humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time,

entries.title: I Peter 5:7
segments: casting all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.

entries.title: I Peter 5:8
segments: ¶Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil walks about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

entries.title: I Peter 5:9
segments: Resist him, steadfast in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are experienced by your brotherhood in the world.

entries.title: I Peter 5:10
segments: ¶But may the God of all grace, who called us to His eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle [you].

entries.title: I Peter 5:11
segments: To Him [be] the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: I Peter 5:12
segments: By Silvanus, our faithful brother as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

entries.title: I Peter 5:13
segments: She who is in Babylon, elect together with [you], greets you; and [so does] Mark my son.

entries.title: I Peter 5:14
segments: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
